R3-01.why: The clearest USP of the five: 'throw a party, hide the evidence before Mom gets home, then Mom hunts you' fits on a thumbnail, and 10 searches found no Roblox game with this asymmetric party, hide and hunt loop. The nearest Roblox titles are adjacent rather than direct. Clean the House! (Snowy Interactive, Jul 2026, about 5-6K peak, 0.9-1.3M visits per RoWatcher) is PvE chores with a 'Mom asked you to clean' framing. Don't Burn the House Down is a single-player chore list before Mom returns. Hide the Body is hide-and-seek. The proven source idea, No Body No Problem! (Oct 2026 Next Fest top 5, 3v1 physics hide-the-evidence), is unreleased, so there is a first-mover window on Roblox. The FREEZE gadget, Snitch and Report Card add identity beyond a reskin. Weaknesses: it borrows the Granny and Scary Teacher hostile-adult trope; the three-phase structure plus a driving minigame is harder to read than the pitch; and once No Body No Problem! launches, AI-assisted clone teams will race to make 'hide the mess from Mom' versions. Defensibility comes only from shipping first and owning the name and characters (the Parent costumes).
R3-01.fix: Ship before or right after No Body No Problem! launches; this lead is the main moat. Make the Parent a named, ownable character with a meme voice and catchphrase (on the level of Granny). Make the physical hiding spots (TV in the oven) the content pillar, with hand-made houses at a monthly cadence that are hard to clone in volume. Cut or shorten the driving minigame if playtests show it blurs the pitch.
R3-01.competitors: Clean the House! (Roblox, ~5-6K peak, PvE); Don't Burn the House Down (Roblox, single-player); Hide the Body (Roblox); Granny / Scary Teacher-style Roblox games; Flee the Facility; No Body No Problem! (Steam, unreleased, likely clone source); itch.io jam games (Panic! at the House Party, Post Party Panic, We'll Be Home Soon) prove the premise is natural and easy to copy.

R3-02.why: Gesture-drawn runes are no longer unique on Roblox. Draw Spells Magic Arena (Re-Bloxian Wizard, Sep 2026, PvP; codes coverage on Destructoid and ProGameGuides in Nov 2026) already owns 'draw spells' in search and thumbnails. The concept rests on a narrower USP: co-op fusion of two simultaneously drawn runes, with relics that change how fusions behave. That is a real, Magicka-like distinction, and I found no co-op draw-spell game on Roblox (searched; not found). But players must grasp the 'fusion' nuance to see it as different, and the wave-defence wrapper sits in one of Roblox's most crowded genres (tower and wave defence; general knowledge, not re-verified here). Defensibility is moderate. The server rune classifier and a 12-fusion matrix take real work to tune, but the Draw Spells Magic Arena developer could add a PvE co-op mode faster than a new studio can build an audience. Timing is fine but not early: the drawing-spell idea is already live and growing.
R3-02.fix: Lead every thumbnail and the game name with the fusion moment (two ink colours colliding into a Firenado), not with drawing. Make 'tandem casting' the signature: two players trace one large rune together, which a PvP arena cannot copy. Consider moving off generic wave defence to a distinctive frame, such as escorting or protecting a moving tower or a giant familiar, so the genre read differs too.
R3-02.competitors: Draw Spells Magic Arena (Roblox, PvP, ~615 CCU per brief); Draw Spells dev test (Roblox); Roblox tower-defence and wave-defence field (Toilet Tower Defense, Anime Defenders and similar; not re-verified); Spellchitects (itch.io, co-op drawing spells); YAPYAP and Magicka (Steam inspirations).

R3-03.why: In effect this is Worst Class Ever (Steam #1 Oct Next Fest, released Nov 9, 2026) moved into a museum, with Red-Light-Green-Light and Weeping-Angel freeze rules. All three are among the most-copied formats on Roblox. Hide-in-plain-sight is established: Be NPC or Die (~301M visits, peak ~10K Nov 2025, now ~1K and declining per RoWatcher), DISGUISE, In Plain Sight and Prank the Teacher (anger-meter pranks). Red Light Green Light games are everywhere after Squid Game. The real twist (only the flashlight beam can tag, battery is limited, statues snap to plinth poses) is solid design, and I found no Roblox statue-flashlight game (searched; not found; the itch.io game The Imitation uses the flashlight-freezes-statues idea). But to a browsing player the USP reads as 'another NPC/disguise game'. The biggest timing risk is that Worst Class Ever just released, so Roblox clones of it are highly likely within weeks. They would occupy the 'prank while blending in, fill the Mischief meter' slot first and blur this concept's identity. Defensibility is low: the beam-tag rule is easy for AI tools to replicate.
R3-03.fix: Push the identity further from Worst Class Ever. Make the flashlight beam and the freeze-pose comedy (statues caught in absurd mid-prank poses) the headline instead of the Mischief meter. Own the museum set with signature exhibits (T-rex, Mona-style portrait, mummy) as a recognisable brand. Ship fast, before the WCE-clone wave, and market it as 'Night at the Museum Red Light Green Light', not as hide-among-NPCs.
R3-03.competitors: Be NPC or Die / NPC or DIE! (Roblox, ~1K now, 10K peak); DISGUISE; In Plain Sight; Prank the Teacher (Roblox); Squid Game Red Light Green Light clones (Roblox); expected Worst Class Ever Roblox clones; Worst Class Ever (Steam); The Imitation (itch.io, statue/flashlight).

R3-04.why: Shared-vehicle co-op is an established Roblox micro-genre. Boat Together [1-6 Player] (PanCommunity, Dec 2025) has ~8.2M visits and a ~2K peak and occupies the exact 'paddle a boat together' slot. Drive It, Left!, Cartphus, Tank Mates and Tandem Trails all split vehicle control between players. Fart Together proved demand (13M+ visits) before its takedown, and that vacuum will draw fast AI-built copies. Steam has Boat Together (Beaked Games), Super Raft Boat Together and Drive Together. The proposed differentiators are seat roles, multi-raft versus with water-bailing into rivals, a Saboteur Seat and a vehicle roster. They are meaningful but incremental, and none is hard to copy: a kinematic raft on a spline is among the easiest systems for an AI-assisted team to clone. The name 'Paddle Panic' already exists on itch.io and vgdb. A player choosing between this and Boat Together would see the same premise with more modes.
R3-04.fix: Make Versus Raft Race with the Saboteur Seat the default headline mode, not a mutator: 'one of you is secretly trying to sink the raft' is a sharper USP than co-op paddling. Treat signature vehicles (bathtub walrus, shopping-cart rocket) as the brand and thumbnail. Rename to avoid the existing 'Paddle Panic' titles. Launch fast into the Fart Together gap.
R3-04.competitors: Boat Together [1-6 Player] (Roblox, 8.2M visits, ~2K peak); Fart Together (Roblox copy, removed); Drive It, Left!, Cartphus, Tank Mates, Tandem Trails (Roblox shared-control vehicles); Boat Together (Steam), Super Raft Boat Together, Drive Together, RV There Yet?, Fart Together (Steam).

R3-05.why: Each half has competition. On the firefighting side: Fire Fighting Simulator, Firefighters! (Rainfall Studios) and Fire Rescue Simulator, all roleplay or sim with no pets. On the animal side: Rescue Animals! (Scratch Labs, ~18-20K peak, now ~3K), Rescue Pets!, UPD Rescue Pets and the 'X for Animals' wave (Jump for Animals, Skate for Animals). I found no Roblox game that combines round-based co-op fire chaos with earned critter companions (searched; not found), and the 'every critter you save becomes your companion' hook is clear and emotionally strong. Firefighters Together (Steam 2025, 1-4 players rescuing kittens) proves the core premise but is not on Roblox. Weaknesses: a thumbnail risks reading as 'another fire sim' or 'another pet game'; Rescue Animals' decline from ~20K to ~3K suggests the animal-rescue trend has peaked; and pet-collection meta is the most cloned layer on Roblox. Defensibility is moderate. The fire-spread grid, fire types and critter behaviours (hiding, wriggling, two-player carries) take more systems work than a kit clone, but a 40-critter roster is easy for AI tools to imitate.
R3-05.fix: Make the critter itself the brand: memorable signature rescues (the panicked elephant calf, the parrot on the ladder) and a comedy 'escaped critter' failure as the thumbnail and clip, with the fire as the setting. Ship the building variety that clones cannot easily copy (pet shop, zoo) early. Show companions on the truck to make each player's collection social proof.
R3-05.competitors: Rescue Animals! (Roblox, ~20K peak, ~3K now); Rescue Pets! / UPD Rescue Pets (Roblox); Fire Fighting Simulator, Firefighters!, Fire Rescue Simulator (Roblox); Jump/Skate for Animals (Roblox trend); Firefighters Together (Steam, kitten rescue co-op); Pet Simulator-style collection games.

overall_notes: Ranking on differentiation: R3-01 (7) > R3-02 = R3-05 (6) > R3-03 = R3-04 (5). No concept reaches 8. Each one ports a proven Steam or Roblox format whose source has direct analogues or imminent clones. R3-01 has the cleanest, most ownable premise and an open window before No Body No Problem! launches. R3-03 faces the most timing risk because Worst Class Ever released on Nov 9 and Roblox clones are likely. R3-04 enters a slot that Boat Together already holds. Defensibility against AI-built clones is weak across the board. The moat in every case is speed to market plus ownable characters and hand-made content (houses, exhibits, critters, vehicles), not mechanics. Method: 10 web searches. Not found on Roblox: a party-cleanup hide-from-parent game, a statue/flashlight freeze game, a co-op draw-spell game, a firefighter pet-rescue game. CCU figures are tracker snapshots that disagree between RoWatcher and Rotrends.
